items.title: Accept the tool migration go-live?
items.about: verify-crewhouse is deleted; its checks live on as done-done journeys stub-drive, static-checks and screens, with a CI job that runs, checks and receipts them. learn-from-mistakes is initialized (agents on the OpenCode Go plan, never Claude; retro run 1 completed over 275 records with no repeated causes). No retro skill and no Lavish use existed to convert. Final done-done receipt is recorded for the merge head; see the PR Checks block.
